title: 创新团队分散，怎样让新品开发更快？
topic: 整合设计、产品和研发协作，让创新更贴近用户需求

source.title: Nike Creates New Innovation Engine to Power Athletes Faster
source.section: Nike Creates New Innovation Engine to Power Athletes Faster
source.type: NIKE 官方产品创新团队与业务战略公告
source.context: Nike 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: Nike, Jordan Brand and Converse are uniting their Innovation, Design and Product teams in a single, athlete-focused creation engine designed to accelerate innovation and drive growth as part of the new NIKE, Inc. Sport Offence.
This structure will help teams share insights, technology and methods of make throughout the innovation process, driving the creation of products that help athletes* perform at their peak.

The move is designed to accelerate athlete-centred innovation and drive growth as part of the new NIKE, Inc. Sport Offence, helping teams share insights, technology and methods of make to drive the creation of more game-changing products for athletes everywhere.

"Our north star is a homage to our co-founder, Bill Bowerman, and a challenge Kobe Bryant put to all of us: 'Create epic s--- and make athletes better'", says Phil McCartney, chief innovation, design and product officer, NIKE, Inc. "Everything begins and ends with the athlete's voice—their goals, their struggles, their drive. By uniting our creation organisation across Nike, Jordan and Converse, we're accelerating progress and fully leveraging our strengths to deliver epic products that make athletes better. It's a new day in Innovation, Design and Product at Nike".
translations: Nike、Jordan Brand 和 Converse 正把创新、设计和产品团队整合为一个以运动员为中心的创新体系，目标是加快创新、推动增长，并服务于 NIKE, Inc. 新的 Sport Offence 战略。
这一架构将帮助团队在整个创新过程中共享洞察、技术和产品实现方法，从而打造帮助运动员发挥最佳水平的产品。
这一调整旨在加快以运动员为中心的创新并推动增长，同时帮助团队共享洞察、技术和制作方法，打造更多能改变运动体验的产品，服务世界各地的运动员。

“我们的创新方向，既是向联合创始人 Bill Bowerman 致敬，也是在回应 Kobe Bryant 对所有人的挑战：‘创造出色的作品，让运动员变得更好。’”Nike, Inc. 首席创新、设计与产品官 Phil McCartney 表示。“一切都始于运动员的声音，也终于运动员的声音——他们的目标、挑战和动力。将 Nike、Jordan 和 Converse 的创新、设计与产品团队整合起来，能让我们加快进展、充分发挥各自优势，推出真正出色、能让运动员变得更好的产品。Nike 的创新、设计和产品工作由此开启新的一页。”
fullTextParagraphs: Nike, Jordan Brand and Converse are uniting their Innovation, Design and Product teams in a single, athlete-focused creation engine designed to accelerate innovation and drive growth as part of the new NIKE, Inc. Sport Offence.
This structure will help teams share insights, technology and methods of make throughout the innovation process, driving the creation of products that help athletes* perform at their peak.
The move comes as Nike unveils its Aero-FIT, Air Milano, Nike Mind and Project Amplify innovation platforms, which reflect an unmatched commitment to solving problems for athletes.

These innovations, and others to come, are born from Nike's relationships with elite and everyday athletes; pioneering design and product-creation teams; and world-class spaces dedicated to creating the future of sport.
Nike Unveils Project Amplify, the World's First Powered-Footwear System for Running and Walking
Nike Debuts its First Neuroscience-Based Footwear to Help Athletes Feel Calm, Focused and Present
Nike Introduces the Therma-FIT Air Milano Jacket, a Bold Evolution in Air Innovation
Nike Unveils Aero-FIT Performance Apparel Innovation: Cooling Technology for a Hotter World
The mission of NIKE, Inc. is simple: bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world.

It's in that spirit that the company is announcing a new chapter in its legacy of innovation for athletes and sport, uniting the Innovation, Design and Product teams across Nike, Jordan Brand and Converse into a single, athlete-focused creation engine.

The move is designed to accelerate athlete-centred innovation and drive growth as part of the new NIKE, Inc. Sport Offence, helping teams share insights, technology and methods of make to drive the creation of more game-changing products for athletes everywhere.

"Our north star is a homage to our co-founder, Bill Bowerman, and a challenge Kobe Bryant put to all of us: 'Create epic s--- and make athletes better'", says Phil McCartney, chief innovation, design and product officer, NIKE, Inc. "Everything begins and ends with the athlete's voice—their goals, their struggles, their drive. By uniting our creation organisation across Nike, Jordan and Converse, we're accelerating progress and fully leveraging our strengths to deliver epic products that make athletes better. It's a new day in Innovation, Design and Product at Nike".

NIKE, Inc. is announcing the new structure as the company unveils four innovation platforms that reflect an unmatched commitment to solving problems for athletes, improving their experience and powering the future of sport.

Aero-FIT is Nike's pinnacle expression of cooling technology, capable of channelling more than double the airflow of legacy Nike athletic apparel to help enable peak performance in extreme conditions.

Nike Mind is a new platform, over 10 years in the making, that comes to life in Nike's first neuroscience-based footwear, the Mind 001 mule and Mind 002 sneaker—a new type of shoe designed to help athletes lock in their mindset pre- and post-competition.
Project Amplify is the world's first powered footwear system for running and walking, designed to help everyday athletes go a little bit faster and further, all with less effort.

Therma-FIT Air Milano leverages Nike Air technology to offer an entirely new sensation in performance outerwear—allowing athletes to regulate their temperature without changing layers, offering warmth levels that range from a hoodie to a midweight puffer.

These innovations represent the depth, breadth and impact of Nike's commitment to athlete-centred innovation, which is now stronger than ever with the unification of the company's Innovation, Design and Product teams.

"Our curious, talented teammates who come together to serve athletes every day, combined with our advantaged resources like the Nike Sport Research Lab, will enable us to deliver future decades of disruptive products and performance breakthroughs", says McCartney. "What comes out of our creation teams isn't just innovative—it's the kind of work that stops people in their tracks. It wows. It resonates. It makes people feel something. And that's the magic".

That magic is the product of nearly 1,000 designers, many working inside the 92,903-square-metre Serena Williams Building on Nike's Philip H. Knight Campus; a dedicated team of bioengineers, neuroscientists and creators in the LeBron James Innovation Center, home to the Nike Sport Research Lab; industry-leading footwear and apparel-creation capabilities in the Bowerman Footwear Lab; and best-in-class manufacturing partners around the world.

"We are a team of dreamers, designers and creators with a responsibility to make athlete dreams real", says McCartney. "We focus on the athlete's unique relationship with their sport, creating solutions they never knew they needed and can't live without. We imagine and innovate—always starting with athletes, staying grounded in sport and pushing what's possible in innovation, design and product".
*If you have a body, you are an athlete.

notes.phrase: uniting their Innovation, Design and Product teams in a single, athlete-focused creation engine
notes.meaning: 把创新、设计和产品团队整合为一个以运动员为中心的创新引擎。

notes.example: Everything begins and ends with the customer's voice.

scenario.title: 产品开发：多个团队重复研究同一用户问题
english: Design, research, and product teams are working on separate concepts for the same athlete need.
Each group has useful insight, but technology and testing methods are not shared across the process.
Propose a shared creation team, explain how it should use athlete feedback, and set an outcome that can guide product decisions.
chinese: 设计、研究和产品团队正在围绕同一项运动员需求分别开发方案。
每个团队都有有用的洞察，但技术和测试方法没有在流程中共享。
请提出共同创新团队，说明如何使用运动员反馈，并设定一个能指导产品决策的结果目标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 设计、研究和产品团队分散推进同一项新品需求。请用英语提出跨团队整合方式，说明共享哪些资源，并把产品目标连接到用户需求。
firstAttempt.sample: We should bring Design, Research, and Product together in one athlete-focused team. The teams can share athlete insights, technology, and product-development methods throughout development. To keep the athlete’s voice at the center, we should test each concept against athletes’ goals and pain points before scaling.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先整合相关团队，再说明共享什么信息，最后用用户需求和明确结果判断产品方案。

words.example: We united the design and product teams around one user problem.
words.translation: 我们围绕一个用户问题整合了设计和产品团队。
words.note: 说明团队从分散协作转为共同工作。

words.example: Research will share user insights with the product team.
words.translation: 研究团队会与产品团队分享用户洞察。
words.note: insight 是能帮助团队理解用户需求的发现。

words.example: We need an athlete-focused design process.
words.translation: 我们需要一个以运动员需求为中心的设计流程。
words.note: 工作中可换成 customer-focused 或 user-focused。

structure.original: Everything begins and ends with the athlete's voice—their goals, their struggles, their drive.
analysis: begins and ends with 把运动员需求放在方案起点，也作为检验结果的依据。
破折号后列出 goals、struggles 和 drive，说明这里的 voice 指真实需求与经历。
在产品沟通中，可把 athlete 换成 user 或 customer。
structure.transfer: Everything begins and ends with the customer's voice: what they need, where they struggle, and what they are trying to achieve.

rewrite.bad: All departments should communicate more and make better products.
rewrite.good: We should bring Innovation, Design, and Product together in one athlete-focused team. They can share athlete insights, technology, and product-development methods throughout development. Before scaling, we should test each concept against athletes’ goals and pain points.
rewrite.translation: 我们应把创新、设计和产品团队整合为一个以运动员为中心的团队。团队可以在整个开发过程中共享运动员洞察、技术和产品开发方法。扩大推广前，应依据运动员的目标和痛点评估每个方案。
rewrite.pattern: We should bring [functions] into one [user-focused] team. They can share [resources] throughout [process]. Evaluate each concept against [user need] before scaling.

choice.prompt: 新品开发涉及创新、设计和产品团队，大家各自保存用户测试结果。哪种调整最可能减少重复工作？
options: Add another approval stage after all teams finish independently.
Create one shared team that exchanges athlete insights, technology, and product-development methods throughout the process, using the athlete problem to guide decisions.
Ask the product team to choose a concept without reviewing user feedback.
choice.why: 第二条把跨团队共享放进整个流程，并让用户问题成为共同判断依据。

output.prompt: 你要推动研发、设计和客户研究围绕同一项功能协作。请提出如何共享用户反馈、统一测试方法，并用什么用户结果决定是否继续开发。
output.sample: We should bring Research, Design, and Engineering into one user-focused team for this feature. Research can share interview findings and a common test plan throughout development. We should continue only if the prototype helps users complete the key task more easily and consistently.
check: 说明要共享的用户反馈和测试方法
用可观察的用户结果决定是否继续
